prerequisites: Distinguish a count from a ratio.
explanation: A percentage is meaningful only after naming its reference whole. Read of, more than, increase from, and among to identify that whole before dividing.

worked.action: A group contains 15 adults and 10 children; children are 10/25 of the group.
worked.justification: The whole group contains both adults and children.

worked.action: Children as a percentage of adults is instead 10/15 times 100%.
worked.justification: The comparison word adults changes the denominator, even though the counts stay the same.

worked.action: For 10 children in a group of 25, compute 10/25 times 100 =40%.
worked.justification: This finishes the part-to-whole calculation using the whole group.

worked.action: Children as a percentage of 15 adults is 10/15 times 100 =66 2/3%.
worked.justification: The selected comparison base is adults, not everyone.

worked.action: If membership grows from 30 to 36, the increase is 6; 6/30 times 100 =20%.
worked.justification: Increase is a difference relative to the original quantity, not the final quantity.

worked.action: If A has 45 tokens and B has 30, A has 15 more; 15/30 times 100 =50% more than B.
worked.justification: More than B names B as the reference. A itself is 150% of B; the excess is only 50%.

hint: Underline the words naming the comparison group.
shortcut: Write the denominator in words before putting in numbers.
limitation: Different questions about the same data can have different bases.

entry.stem: A basket holds 8 apples and 12 pears. For the fraction of all fruit that is apples, what is the denominator?
explanations: All fruit totals 8+12=20.
8 counts the selected apples, not all fruit.
12 counts only pears.
4 is the count difference, not the whole.
repairs: All fruit totals 8+12=20. Reconstruct the stated whole and operation before trying a fresh problem.
8 counts the selected apples, not all fruit. Reconstruct the stated whole and operation before trying a fresh problem.
12 counts only pears. Reconstruct the stated whole and operation before trying a fresh problem.
4 is the count difference, not the whole. Reconstruct the stated whole and operation before trying a fresh problem.
entry.reason_prompt: Which equation or base statement supports the result?
reason_options: The whole is apples plus pears
The whole is only the selected apples
